Samira (People Ops): :loudspeaker: New short-term policy live — Emergency Travel Advance for urgent family/caregiver situations. Form + FAQ below.

Priya (People Ops): Quick summary: one-time advance up to $2,000 for last-minute flights, visas, emergency medical travel. Same-day approvals if docs submitted before 2:00pm PT. Repayment options include payroll deduction, one-off card charge, or manager-reviewed grant conversion.

Avi (Eng): Does this apply to international flights and expedited visa fees?

Samira (People Ops): Yes 10%. Covers international travel, visa-expedite fees, and basic emergency lodging when directly tied to the covered event. Please attach supporting docs (itinerary, airline confirmation, hospital/agency note).

Raj (Finance): Accounting tag will be "Employee Emergency Travel" for advances <$2k. If repayment via payroll deduction is selected, we'll schedule it across the next paycheck cycle unless you opt for immediate card charge. Manager + People Ops can approve converting an advance to a grant in exceptional cases.

Priya (People Ops): Submit here: https://forms.redwood/emergency-travel-advance — include one-line rationale, attachment(s), and preferred repayment method. Put "emergency-advance" in the subject or form field for priority routing.

Eli (People Ops): Also launching a pilot backup-care stipend: $500/year (one-time enrollment) to help with last-minute childcare/eldercare or licensed in-home care while you handle an emergency. It's opt-in and we'll measure utilization over 6 months.

Avi (Eng): If I enroll in backup-care, is that taxable?

Raj (Finance): It may be taxable depending on local regs. We'll provide a tax summary per region in the FAQ. People Ops will surface gross-up options for covered employees where applicable.

Eli (People Ops): New requirement for company-funded offsites: a short Code of Conduct acknowledgment must be completed during travel preapproval. Expense reports and travel approvals will be blocked until the CoC ack is recorded for that trip. This only affects company-sponsored travel.

Avi (Eng): So personal trips / personal reimbursements aren7t affected?

Samira (People Ops): Correct. This only applies to company-sponsored or company-funded events/offsites. If you need an accommodation for the CoC statement (religious, medical, accessibility), DM People Ops and we'll provide an alternative path.

peopleops-bot: Reminder schedule set: "Offsite CoC ack due" will ping registered attendees at 7 days and again at 2 days before departure.

Priya (People Ops): We know emergencies are stressful. Finance can help with private walkthroughs of the form if you7d like. Reply here or DM and we'll assist.

Samira (People Ops): Q&A session tomorrow 11:00am PT in #people-ops-ama to go through examples (international cases, repayment flows, backup-care eligibility). Bring scenarios if you want help filling the form.

Avi (Eng): Thanks, appreciate the clarity.

Samira (People Ops): :pray: Thanks team — full policy and FAQ: https://docs.redwood/internal/emergency-travel-backupcare-faq
